bibliographic_record.title: Synchronization in oscillator networks with delayed coupling: A stability criterion
bibliographic_record.authors: Earl, M. G.; Strogatz, S. H.

verbatim_excerpt: Physical Review E 67, 036204 (2003). Cited consistently across the delay-coupled oscillator literature as establishing the stability criterion for phase-locked states in ring networks of identical phase oscillators with delayed coupling: locking conditions are transcendental in the delay and must be solved for the collective frequency, not checked as an algebraic sum. (Bibliographic record plus the cited characterisation; the abstract itself was not opened - see notes.)
